purpose: Pre-optimization HPC baseline inputs; measured results live outside source fixtures

comparison_policy.reference: Fresh single-rank run of the recorded source snapshot, alongside existing independent numerical gates
comparison_policy.speedup_claim: Median end-to-end time reduction at least 10 percent across at least three fresh-process repetitions, with no numerical gate regression
comparison_policy.memory_scope: Maximum per-rank and aggregate peak RSS; scope and sum-of-peaks caveat must be recorded
comparison_policy.note: These cross-configuration comparison limits supplement, never replace or loosen, native fixture assertions. Pressure references must use identical gauge and units.

cases.precision_note: The small numerical reference uses direct MUMPS on both rank configurations. Default-solver pressure comparison measured 1.20546e-6 and failed the unchanged 1e-6 gate. Tightened iterative single-rank solve timed out at 240 s; both failed observations are preserved. This reference choice is not a scalable-preconditioner claim or a change to production defaults.
